analytics.name: Analytic 0747
analytics.guidance: Detects adversarial archiving using libraries (zlib, zip APIs) invoked by scripts or binaries. Correlates process executions of Python, PowerShell, or custom .NET binaries with DLL/module loads linked to compression libraries, followed by archive file creation.

tuning.description: Known business applications using compression libraries.
Archive extensions considered sensitive in monitored environments.
Correlation window between script/library invocation and file creation.

analytics.name: Analytic 0748
analytics.guidance: Detects adversarial archiving by scripts or binaries calling compression libraries (libzip, zlib, bzip2). Correlates execution of Python, Perl, or compiled binaries with dynamic linking to archiving libraries and creation of compressed files in /tmp or user directories.

tuning.description: List of shared objects linked to compression/encryption.
Directories where archive creation is flagged as anomalous.
Entropy level used to distinguish encryption from normal compression.

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: execve: Execution of python, perl, or custom binaries invoking compression libraries

log_sources.name: auditd:MMAP
log_sources.channel: load: Loading of libzip.so, libz.so, or libbz2.so by processes not normally associated with archiving

log_sources.name: auditd:FILE
log_sources.channel: create: Creation of .zip, .gz, .bz2 files in /tmp, /var/tmp, or /home directories

analytics.name: Analytic 0749
analytics.guidance: Detects malicious archiving via system or third-party libraries (libz, libarchive) invoked by Python, Swift, or Objective-C binaries. Correlates unified logs of library loads with creation of compressed or encrypted archives (.zip, .gz, .bz2, .dmg).

tuning.description: Applications allowed to load compression libraries (e.g., backup agents).
Flag archiving under privileged or system accounts as suspicious.
Targeted monitoring of sensitive file formats or compressed containers.

log_sources.channel: Execution of Python, Swift, or other binaries invoking archiving libraries

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Loading of libz.dylib, libarchive.dylib by non-standard applications

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Creation of .zip, .gz, .dmg archives in /Users, /tmp, or application directories
